message:
I took the test too -- not that one because I didn't want to register with the site -- but [this one](http://www.humanmetrics.com/cgi-win/JTypes3.asp). I am now* an ENTJ:

    * slightly expressed extravert (22%)
    * slightly expressed intuitive personality (12%)
    * slightly expressed thinking personality (12%)
    * very expressed judging personality (89%)

This type, on MyPersonality.info, is called [The Chief](http://www.mypersonality.info/personality-types/entj/).

* I took the test about eight years ago and was an ENFP, but I can't remember how strongly expressed an ENFP I was.
